text:
Alex M: Heads up — competitor just announced segmented latency tiers for inference. ACME pinged us asking for a low-cost 'fast-lite' offering. Do we make this a priority?
Maya C: Link? +1 on ACME ask, they've flagged per-token cost as a blocker.
Alex M: https://example.com/comp-announcement — they call it 'economy route'. ACME wants something similar for chat and embeddings.
Jon P: We already have batching + quant profiles in the lab. Potential quick win: expose an 'economy quant' + stricter token caps and prefix caching. Low lift?
Rachel S: Multi-tier routing impacts SLOs and rollouts. We need clear acceptance criteria, per-route fallbacks, and a rollback plan.
Maya C: Proposal: run a pilot experiment for a 'fast-lite' tier with targets: p95 ~200ms, token cap 512, aim for ~25% token-cost reduction, allow up to 3% quality regression on our eval set. Canary to 5% traffic first.
Alex M: Good. Launch criteria should include: 1) actual cost delta measured on production query mix, 2) fidelity/pass rate on representative prompt set, 3) no increase in error-rate or tail latency beyond thresholds. Auto-fallback to standard models on errors.
Jon P: Dev estimate: 2 sprints runtime changes (routing + quant modes) + 1 sprint console and billing flags + 1 spike in Optimize for suggestion rules. Ops: need a canary routing policy and metric spike alerts.
Rachel S: Sales ask — can we get ACME to join pilot and sign telemetry MOU? If pilot is on Dedicated or Private for them, scope increases. @Jon P can you take infra ownership for the pilot?
Jon P: I can own pilot infra. Initial config draft: `routing { tiers: [fast-lite, standard]; fallback: standard; token_cap: 512; quant_profile: economy_v1 }`
Maya C: :thumbsup: I'll draft acceptance criteria doc and add the eval prompt set. Also check pricing delta for hosted vs dedicated.
Alex M: Decision: Move to a scoped spike next sprint. If pilot meets >=25% cost reduction and <=3% quality drop on the chosen evals, promote to MVP. Otherwise kill the spike.
Rachel S: Also add per-tenant SLA gating; if any enterprise asks for private deployment we need to surface compliance/cost impact.
prod-bot: Reminder — create Jira ticket and add stakeholders for pilot.
Alex M: Created INV-2345: https://jira.example.com/browse/INV-2345 — tagging stakeholders. Ping me if you want in the pilot.
